description:
FOUND (s526w1, YAML-Tiny census, after #3832 let the TestML data load): both files die "Modification of a read-only value attempted" (the run-dist-t form at line 84 / 93 of the transpiled program); perl runs both to the end (31: all rows; 30: no plan, 2+ rows).  Both drive t/lib/TestBridge.pm's run_all_testml_files -> test_yaml_roundtrip / test_yaml_json / test_load_good, which loop `for (qw(serializes)) { ... $options{$_} = 1 }` (a read-only literal aliased to $_), then `eval $perl` and nested subtests.
NOT ISOLATED: the obvious shapes (a write to $_ after a `for (qw(...))` loop, inside and outside a sub; s/// on a foreach copy) all agree with perl (scratch p-ro.pl).  Next step: bisect TestBridge.pm's test_* functions with one tml file, under ./runpcl, printing before each statement.  Related: #1391 / #936 (the read-only family, the opposite direction -- PCL usually MISSES perl's read-only error).
Rows: YAML-Tiny 31_local_tml.t *FILE*, 30_yaml_spec_tml.t *PLAN*.
subject: A "Modification of a read-only value attempted" PERL DOES NOT RAISE stops YAML-Tiny t/31_local_tml.t (before its first row) and t/30_yaml_spec_tml.t (after row 2) -- not isolated
